Privacy Policy

Effective 12 October 2026

How account, route, and shipment information is handled.

Information we use

The app may use account details, contact information, saved places, shipment requests, route details, payment records, support messages, and device permission choices to provide cargo services and customer support.

Why we use it

Information is used to create and manage shipment requests, send operational updates, produce invoices and receipts, improve service support, protect customer accounts, and meet applicable operational requirements.

When information is shared

Only the information needed for a shipment or support request may be shared with relevant service teams, delivery partners, payment providers, or authorities where required. Marketing preferences do not control essential cargo or billing updates.

Your choices

You can manage communication preferences, saved places, recipients, recognized devices, and data-control requests in Account settings. Requesting data export or account deletion starts a review process; it does not immediately remove records required for an active shipment or legal obligation.

Security and contact

Use a unique password and review recognized devices regularly. Contact Support through the app if you believe your account or information has been used without permission.

Who is responsible

Newworld Cargo, operated by New World Investments Limited, provides this app. Contact info@newworldcargo.com about privacy or account deletion, or write to Shop 62/A, Carousel Shopping Centre, Lusaka, Zambia.

Device permissions and selected files

Camera access is used when you scan labels or take cargo evidence photos. Foreground location helps select pickup and delivery places; the app does not request background location. Contacts access lets you choose delivery contact details. Selected images and documents may be uploaded for your profile or support requests. Android's photo picker provides access only to images you select. Notifications are optional operational updates. You can deny permissions and enter addresses and contact details manually.

App activity and diagnostics

The app sends operational events, app version, platform, and filtered diagnostic properties to Newworld Cargo's API for service reliability. Passwords and authentication tokens are excluded from these event properties. Our service providers may process network information such as IP addresses when delivering API, mapping, hosting, and payment services.

Retention and account deletion

Request deletion from Settings > Delete account or email info@newworldcargo.com with the subject Newworld Cargo account deletion and your registered email or phone number. Do not send passwords or payment PINs. We verify ownership before deleting the account and associated profile, saved contacts, saved places, and uploaded personal data that we no longer need. Shipment, invoice, payment, fraud-prevention, and dispute records may be retained where required to complete a service or satisfy legal obligations, and only for as long as those obligations apply. We explain any retained categories and applicable retention period when responding to your request. Deletion requests are not completed immediately in the app.

Requests and policy changes

You can contact info@newworldcargo.com to request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal information, or ask about international processing by our delivery and technology providers. We may need to verify your identity. We update this policy when our practices change and show the effective date here. The app is intended for customers arranging cargo services and is not directed at children.
